_README: Sample data for the home-page lottery panel. See data/README.md for the full contract. JSON has no comment syntax, so the notes below live in _note_* keys that the renderer ignores. Delete them in production if you like — they change nothing.
_note_game: Plain game name shown on the panel and drawn into the own-made SVG badge. Free text.
_note_drawNumber: Integer draw number. Shown as 'Draw 4512'. Omit or null to hide.
_note_drawDate: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the draw. Rendered in en-AU long form.
_note_winningNumbers: Array of the main winning numbers, in draw order. Rendered as number balls.
_note_supplementary: Optional array of supplementary numbers. Rendered as outlined balls after a divider. Use [] or omit if the game has none.
_note_powerball: Optional single Powerball number (for the Powerball game). null/omit for other games.
_note_jackpot: Optional free-text line under the numbers. Omit to hide.
_note_badgeColour: Colour of the own-made SVG badge. MUST be one of the site palette: #E1251B (red), #111111 (black) or #FF6E63 (red-on-dark). Anything else is snapped back to #E1251B by the renderer.
_note_logoSlot: OPTIONAL local asset path under assets/lottery/ for a badge image the owner is licensed to use (e.g. 'assets/lottery/game-badge.svg'). LOCAL FILES ONLY — never an external URL, never a trademarked lottery logo. Left empty (the default), the panel draws its own SVG badge from game + badgeColour.
_note_posterSlot: OPTIONAL local asset path under assets/lottery/ for an owner-supplied poster image (e.g. 'assets/lottery/current-poster.jpg'). LOCAL FILES ONLY. If the file is missing or empty, the poster slot hides itself cleanly.
_note_ctaHref: Optional link for the 'Check your numbers' button. Omit to hide the button.
_note_updated: Optional ISO timestamp of when this file was last refreshed. Shown as a small 'Updated …' note.
